card.name: Words leading into fluid retention
card.fires_on: Small words and word parts just before fluid retention or edema terms in steroid and hormone labels, such as 'salt and' then 'water', 'degree of', or 'increased fluid'.

modes.label: Salt and water retention

modes.label: Link words before fluid retention
modes.description: Words such as 'of' or 'toward' right before 'fluid retention' or 'edema' in estrogen or androgen warnings.
modes.example: Estrogens may cause some degree<< of>> fluid retention.

modes.label: Steroid effect lists
modes.description: Words inside lists of steroid effects, such as a drug name or a word introducing symptoms.
